summary.taskName: Test Leave History Filtering and Pagination

test_plan.objective: Verify filtering accuracy by status and leave type, correct empty-state messaging, pagination boundary conditions, and mobile responsiveness of the Leave History table.

in_scope: Default history table renders on dashboard load
Status filter shows only matching rows
Empty state message when no results match filter
Pagination Previous button disabled correctly on first page
Mobile viewport (375px) — table scrolls horizontally and remains readable
out_of_scope: Backend API filtering logic (covered by API tests)

entry_criteria: Employee with leave history records (multiple statuses)
risks: Pagination test requires >10 leave records to trigger multiple pages

test_cases.title: History table renders with rows on dashboard load
preconditions: At least one leave request exists
steps: Assert table body contains at least one row
test_cases.expected_result: Table renders with ≥1 row of leave history data.

test_cases.title: Status filter returns only rows matching selected status
preconditions: Leave requests with multiple statuses exist
steps: Assert all visible status badges show 'PENDING'
Assert all visible status badges show 'CANCELLED'
test_cases.expected_result: Only rows matching the selected status are displayed.

test_cases.title: Empty state message when filter yields no results
steps: Select a status filter that has no records
Assert 'No requests found matching your filters.' message is displayed
test_cases.expected_result: Empty-state paragraph shown when no results match the filter.

test_cases.title: Pagination Previous button disabled on first page
steps: If pagination controls visible, assert Previous button is disabled
test_cases.expected_result: Previous button disabled on page 1, or pagination absent for single-page data.

test_cases.title: History table is readable on mobile viewport (375px)
steps: Assert table element is present in DOM
test_cases.expected_result: Table renders with overflow-x container and headers on 375px viewport.

subtask_breakdown.subtaskName: Execute test cases for all status and leave type filter combinations
